instruction: An item costs 246 dollars including 23 percent sales tax. The tax is calculated on the price before tax. What is the price of the item before tax, in whole dollars? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
